title: Euler characteristics of coherent sheaves twisted by several line bundles on proper schemes are numerical polynomials bounded by support dimension
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof must establish polynomiality without assuming projectivity or positivity of the line bundles. It removes embedded points, passes to the annihilator subscheme, and uses a regular meromorphic section with denominator ideal to express every finite difference as an Euler function on strictly smaller-dimensional support.
